title: Apply new PKC Urban Capital brand palette via theme tokens and remove hardcoded colors

requirements.summary: Update global Tailwind/CSS-variable theme tokens to match the new background, gold accent, and text colors.
acceptanceCriteria: In the dark theme, primary background renders as #0B1C2D across the site (no remaining #0f172a/#0a0f1a hardcoded backgrounds).
Primary/accent UI elements (buttons, highlights, icons using theme tokens like primary/accent/ring) render as gold #C6A75E (or an OKLCH equivalent that visually matches #C6A75E).
Heading text renders as #F5F5F5 (or a visually matching token equivalent), and secondary/subtext renders as #B8C0CC (or a visually matching token equivalent).
Theme tokens remain compatible with the existing Tailwind + CSS variable setup (e.g., oklch(var(--...)) usage continues to work).

file_operations.description: Update the `.dark` (and any necessary supporting) CSS variable tokens to visually match: background #0B1C2D, primary/accent/ring gold #C6A75E, heading/foreground #F5F5F5, muted-foreground/subtext #B8C0CC, while preserving the existing OKLCH CSS variable pattern used by Tailwind (e.g., `oklch(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)`).

Verify Tailwind color token mappings correctly reflect updated CSS variables (background/foreground/primary/accent/ring/muted) and remain compatible with the existing `oklch(var(--...))` setup; adjust only if required to ensure alpha variants (e.g., `/95`, `/80`) continue to work.

requirements.summary: Replace hardcoded hex colors in layout/sections/components with theme tokens so the new palette applies consistently site-wide.
acceptanceCriteria: No core layout/section components use the old hardcoded background colors (e.g., #0f172a, #0a0f1a) for page/section backgrounds; they use theme tokens or the new #0B1C2D palette.
Header background and transparency styling uses the new primary background color (including any /95, /80 variants).
Hero section base background and gradient overlay are updated to the new primary background color and remain visually legible with the texture overlay.
Floating WhatsApp button focus ring offset color matches the updated primary background (replacing any old background hex usage).

file_operations.description: Replace the app shell hardcoded background (`bg-[#0f172a]`) with theme tokens (e.g., `bg-background`) so the global background follows the updated palette.

Replace hardcoded header background colors (`bg-[#0f172a]/...`) with theme tokens (e.g., `bg-background/95` and `supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/80`) to match the new primary background and maintain translucency behavior.

Replace hardcoded hero section base background and gradient overlay colors (`#0f172a` variants) with theme tokens derived from the updated background (e.g., `bg-background` and gradient `from-background/...`), keeping the texture overlay legible and consistent with the new palette.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0a0f1a]`) with theme tokens so the section background is driven by the updated palette.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0f172a]`) with theme tokens to ensure consistent application of the updated primary background.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0f172a]`) with theme tokens so the calculator section uses the updated palette consistently.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0f172a]` in both form and success views) with theme tokens so the lead form section inherits the updated primary background.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0a0f1a]`) with theme tokens so testimonials styling matches the updated palette.
Replace hardcoded section background (`bg-[#0a0f1a]`) with theme tokens so the section aligns with the updated palette.
Replace hardcoded footer background (`bg-[#0a0f1a]`) with theme tokens so the footer matches the updated primary background palette.

Update the WhatsApp button focus ring offset styling to use theme tokens (e.g., `focus:ring-offset-background`) instead of the old hardcoded background hex (`focus:ring-offset-[#0f172a]`), keeping the ring color aligned with the WhatsApp green as needed.
